note: The fixed bench set (BashCutPro#58). Inputs are globs under the raw folder (the workspace's resources/raw/, never committed; licences in its SOURCES.md). Each job runs once with the Pro kit headless (batch runner #45 with an agent step) and once with the Swift BashCut on a mac, from the same brief.

jobs.title: Talking head to a vertical short
jobs.brief: A 45-60 s vertical short from the talking-head take: strongest line first, fillers and long pauses cut, punch-ins, burned-in captions.

jobs.title: Daily vlog to 60 s
jobs.brief: A 60 s daily vlog from the clips: moments in order, a diary voice line or captions, one calm music bed.

jobs.title: Podcast to three clips
jobs.brief: Three standalone 30-60 s clips by quote from the podcast, word-exact edges, one sequence and one export each, captions burned in.

jobs.title: B-roll montage to music
jobs.brief: A 30 s montage of the b-roll cut to the music's beat, no voice, a look applied consistently.

jobs.title: Tutorial with captions
jobs.brief: A tutorial from the screen recording and voice: the result first, step cards, a zoom per narration line, waiting sped up, captions.

jobs.title: Vietnamese subtitles
jobs.brief: The English talk with Vietnamese subtitles: transcribe, translate keeping timing (translate-captions plugin), a Vietnamese font, burned in.
